metadata.question: Did sea surface temperatures near the coast of La Jolla, California exceed 23 degrees Celcius on August 1, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: La Jolla, California coast (approximately 32.85°N, -117.27°W) - Date: August 1, 2018 - Collection: NOAA/CDR/SST_WHOI for sea surface temperature data - Alternative: HYCOM or other SST products if needed 2. Masking strategy: - Check for valid SST data (quality flags if available) - SST should be in reasonable range (typically -2°C to 35°C for ocean) - No cloud masking needed for SST data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid SST near La Jolla in August should be ~15-25°C - If result is None/NaN → C3 - If no images → C1 - If no valid pixels after processing → C2 - If SST > 23°C → A (Yes) - If SST ≤ 23°C → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laJolla = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.27, 32.85]); const startDate = '2018-08-01'; const endDate = '2018-08-02'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/SST_WHOI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(laJolla); const collectionSize = sstCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`SST Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try alternative SST dataset sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(laJolla); const altSize = sstCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Alternative SST Images found: ${altSize}`); if (altSize === 0) { console.log("No SST data available for this date/location."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing const sstImage = sstCollection.mean(); const sstBand = sstImage.select('sea_surface_temperature').multiply(0.01); // Convert to Celsius // Check pixel count const pixelCount = sstBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: laJolla.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation const sstValue = sstBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laJolla.buffer(5000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Sea Surface Temperature: ${sstValue ? sstValue.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); if (sstValue === null || sstValue === undefined || isNaN(sstValue)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); } else if (sstValue < -2 || sstValue > 35) { console.log("Temperature out of valid range."); console.log("C3"); } else if (sstValue > 23) { console.log("Temperature exceeds 23°C."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Temperature does not exceed 23°C."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
